words: An Ethiopian folk tale, retold in Amharic: a wife is told to bring three whiskers from a living lion.
Look: paper puppets, sets drawn in code — no painted art, no image budget.
look: Paper puppets in front of sets drawn in code: mud-plaster hut with one window on the evening, and a bush at dusk. The lion is never seen — a growl, a shake of the leaves, two amber lamps.
